I replied to June in the thread on #strategic-pod. The ticket Gideon closed with support on 1 Jul was **#8841**.

The answer comes from Gideon's 1 Jul post in the channel. He didn't give any more detail there. The files I can see have no ticket records for this account, so I couldn't check it against anything else.
